property_summary: If play succeeds (does not revert) when called with any amount, then afterwards c.pot is either increased by the sent amount (when no payout happened) or reset to 0 (when payout happened); i.e., pot is either pot_before + amount or 0.

If play is called with the correct ticket amount (10) it never reverts and either transfers out the entire pot (making pot==0 and reducing contract balance accordingly) or increases pot by 10 (so pot == pot_before + 10); in particular, when amount==10 the call cannot revert.
If play is called with any Ether amount, then it reverts unless the amount equals 10; equivalently, play returns (does not revert) only when amount == 10.

After a play call that succeeds (does not revert) with the correct ticket amount, either the contract's pot becomes 0 and the bank received exactly FEE_AMOUNT (1) from the contract balance, or the pot increases by the ticket amount and no Ether left the contract (so contract balance increased by ticket); i.e., when play doesn't revert the contract balance change equals either +TICKET_AMOUNT or -FEE_AMOUNT, accordingly observable via address(c).balance.
